agency.name: Office of Behavioral Health, Maine Department of Health and Human Services

narrNote: MARR appears on NARR's official affiliate list; it is Maine's NARR affiliate and the state-recognized certifier of recovery residences (DHHS/OBH contracts certification to MARR under 5 MRS 20005(22)).
notes: Agency identity from SAMHSA's Single State Agency directory (NASADAD SSA listing: Office of Behavioral Health, Maine DHHS); OBH's own page fetched and verified, including the Maine Crisis Line (888-568-1112, call/text/chat 24/7) and 211 Maine. No general agency phone was published on the fetched OBH page, so agency.phone is null. MaineCare covers substance use treatment under Behavioral Health Services (MaineCare Benefits Manual Ch. II, Section 65); the linked Office of MaineCare Services 'Covered Services & Benefits' page is the member-facing benefits page. PRCC is a peer-run recovery community organization and hub for Maine's network of recovery community centers. countyDirectory is null: Maine publishes no official county-level behavioral-health directory; services are administered statewide through OBH.
